function: Multi-agent DQN: each UAV chooses flying direction and transmit power level; BS allocates PRBs by non-learned graph coloring; goal is service provider profit (p. 6, p. 8).
system: BS, 3 UAVs, 100 UEs by default (sweeps: 50-250 UEs, 2-5 UAVs); antenna gains only, no arrays; 2 GHz, 20 MHz; no RIS (p. 8, p. 9).
method: Multi-agent DQN (3 hidden layers 500/400/300), decentralized per UAV, reinforcement learning on a profit reward; graph coloring for PRBs is not learned (p. 6, p. 9).
data_channel: Custom simulator: distance-based path-loss gain (Eq. 4) and SINR with PRB reuse; UE positions random per episode; no 3GPP, measured or public data (p. 4, p. 8).
test_conditions: Trained 5000 episodes, 3 UAVs and 100 UEs (Fig. 5); sweeps over UEs, UAVs, capacity, latency (Figs. 6-9) do not say whether retrained (p. 8, p. 9).
baselines: Learned: MACEL [6], MADQL. Non-learned: optimal solution by Gurobi, greedy (maximum power, random PRBs) (p. 9).
metrics: Total profit (also as percent of the optimum), UAV energy consumption, average service latency, training reward convergence (p. 9, p. 10).
complexity: Big-O orders: decentralized MaDRL O(U^2), graph coloring O(|V|^3), whole MaDRC O(|V|^3); no FLOPs or runtime (p. 8).
q1_support: p. 4: "d0 is the far field reference distance" with a custom distance-based channel gain (Eq. 4) and SINR; no 3GPP, DeepMIMO or measured channel is mentioned.
q2_support: p. 9: "Fig. 5 illustrates the training results obtained by deploying 3 UAVs to serve 100 UEs"; the sweeps of Figs. 6-9 over 50-250 UEs and 2-5 UAVs never say whether the trained model is reused or retrained.
q3_support: p. 9: "We have compared our outcomes with the existing MACEL model [6]" (earlier learned method) and "the greedy approach positions UAVs to maximize the number of UEs served" (non-learned, with the Gurobi optimum); result: "achieves a profit of 99.05% in comparison to optimal profit".
q4_support: p. 8: "complexity the proposed algorithm can be given as" O(|V|^3), after O(U^2) for the decentralized MaDRL; orders of complexity are reported.
q5_support: p. 8: "We have plotted different results as per the experiment settings mentioned in Table III"; a simulated environment, with no code or data link and no public dataset.
notes: Included through the aerial-link clause of check 4: the learned power level is a physical-layer decision taken jointly with UAV placement (above PHY), while PRB allocation by graph coloring is not learned (p. 8). Area 6 (aerial links, power control); single-antenna links are admitted for area 6. q2 is 0 because the sweeps do not say if the model trained with 3 UAVs and 100 UEs was reused or retrained. The Gurobi optimum is the non-learned baseline.
